originalTarget.historyCoverage: Latest at most 2000 trades; not a complete launch-era replay. Missing earlier state is not backfilled.

replay.limitation: Indexed transaction prices only; no historical amount-sensitive quotes or subsecond observations. Executability, P&L and capture remain unknown.

cohort: Comparison cohort only: five most-traded exact LONG5 symbols among the first 100 search results; these do not substitute for the original target.
